criterion: Correct skill use and qualifying revisions; not proficiency.
label: Experience

criterion: Require a successful request, proposal, commitment or response about action. Merely describing a desire or future event is insufficient.
description: Request, propose and negotiate shared or individual action.
label: Coordinating action

criterion: Require a correctly expressed feeling, desire, preference or position. An ordinary factual assertion is not automatically an opinion.
description: Express internal states, evaluations and positions.
label: Feelings and viewpoints

criterion: Require successful information seeking or a relevant informative response. Question-shaped requests for action do not qualify just for their form.
description: Seek, supply and verify information relevant to the exchange.
label: Information exchange

criterion: Require a successful opening, response, turn/topic action or repair. Sending any message or quoting a greeting does not automatically qualify.
description: Establish contact, coordinate turns and repair mutual understanding.
label: Managing conversation

criterion: Require an identifiable referent and a correctly expressed property, spatial relation, quantity or relationship. Naming alone does not demonstrate every function in this group.
description: Establish referents and describe properties, locations, quantities and relationships.
label: People, things, and places

criterion: Distinguish ability, permission, obligation and likelihood. Similar wording can serve a request instead; judge the actual function.
description: Express capability, permission, requirements and epistemic limits.
label: Possibilities and constraints

criterion: Require a correctly expressed relationship between ideas. Sequence alone is not causation, a condition or an argument.
description: Relate propositions through explanation, consequence, condition, contrast and support.
label: Reasons and connections

criterion: One correctly expressed temporal relationship is sufficient. Present properties alone do not establish temporal skill. Judge meaning in context, not a tense label.
description: Locate events in time and express their temporal structure.
label: Time and events
